label: PF Backlog 41
title: Per-user/tenant capacity + RBAC layered on core/capacity.py
body: core/capacity.py enforces GLOBAL limits only (config/capacity.json: max_parallel_projects, max_created_projects, max_supervisors, max_concurrent_agents_per_project, provider_limits, global_budget). Requirement (P3, owner): evaluate limits with a USER/TENANT context - each user has a capacity profile (quotas over the global defaults); global limits stay the hard ceiling, the user quota is the effective limit. Enforce on every dashboard create/start via the same can_add()/can_start() checks parameterized by user. Pair with dashboard user management (roles per portfolio/project: owner/admin, create, read-only), audit logging, and per-tenant credential protection + data isolation.
